Analytics: EMEA, AMER, or OTHER.

`OTHER` is the deliberate catch-all for an unmapped country. It is never null, so a new
market shows up as an `accepted_values` failure on this column rather than as a

Sales region derived from the customer's country code by the mapping owned by Finance

`OTHER` is the deliberate catch-all for an unmapped country. It is never null, so a new
market shows up as an `accepted_values` failure on this column rather than as a
`not_null` failure three models downstream.

Guest checkouts have no customer and therefore no region. Those rows carry a null region
and are still counted in revenue — see `fct_orders.customer_id`.
AS-IS, NOT AS-WAS. This is the customer's region at the time this model last built, denormalized from dim_customers so a dashboard need not join. Because dim_customers is SCD Type 1 (overwrite), a customer who moves has ALL of their historical orders re-attributed to the new region on the next run.
Finance accepted that: they report on where a customer is now. If you need revenue attributed to the region the customer was in when the order was placed, join fct_orders to customers_snapshot on the half-open dbt_valid_from / dbt_valid_to interval instead — that is what the snapshot exists for.

The order's business status, normalized from Shopify's `financial_status`.

Precedence: a refund overrides any fulfillment state. An order that shipped and was then
refunded reports `refunded`, because the finance question this mart answers is "what did
we keep", not "what left the warehouse".

A status Shopify introduces that we have not mapped falls through to `unknown` rather
than null. Shopify has added enum values twice; `unknown` turns that into a loud
`accepted_values` failure instead of silent nulls.

Values: `pending`, `paid`, `fulfilled`, `refunded`, `cancelled`, `unknown`.

views.name: average_order_value
views.statement:
WITH num AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('day', fct_orders.ordered_at) AS metric_time,
         SUM(CAST(fct_orders.order_amount_usd AS DECIMAL(28,6))) AS num
  FROM fct_orders
  WHERE (fct_orders.order_status != 'cancelled')
  GROUP BY 1
),
den AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('day', fct_orders.ordered_at) AS metric_time,
         COUNT(fct_orders.order_id) AS den
  FROM fct_orders
  WHERE (fct_orders.order_status != 'cancelled')
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT den.metric_time AS metric_time,
       CAST(COALESCE(num.num, 0) AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(CAST(den.den AS DOUBLE), 0) AS average_order_value
FROM den LEFT JOIN num ON num.metric_time IS NOT DISTINCT FROM den.metric_time

properties.description: Revenue divided by order count, both excluding cancelled orders.

views.name: emea_revenue_share
views.statement:
WITH num AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('day', fct_orders.ordered_at) AS metric_time,
         SUM(CAST(fct_orders.order_amount_usd AS DECIMAL(28,6))) AS num
  FROM fct_orders
    LEFT JOIN dim_customers ON fct_orders.customer_id = dim_customers.customer_id
  WHERE (fct_orders.order_status != 'cancelled')
    AND (dim_customers.region = 'EMEA')
  GROUP BY 1
),
den AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('day', fct_orders.ordered_at) AS metric_time,
         SUM(CAST(fct_orders.order_amount_usd AS DECIMAL(28,6))) AS den
  FROM fct_orders
  WHERE (fct_orders.order_status != 'cancelled')
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT den.metric_time AS metric_time,
       CAST(COALESCE(num.num, 0) AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(CAST(den.den AS DOUBLE), 0) AS emea_revenue_share
FROM den LEFT JOIN num ON num.metric_time IS NOT DISTINCT FROM den.metric_time

properties.description: Share of revenue from EMEA customers. Guest checkouts have no region and are excluded from the numerator but included in the denominator.

views.name: order_count
views.statement:
SELECT date_trunc('day', fct_orders.ordered_at) AS metric_time,
       COUNT(fct_orders.order_id) AS order_count
FROM fct_orders
WHERE (fct_orders.order_status != 'cancelled')
GROUP BY 1

properties.description: Count of non-cancelled orders, excluding internal test accounts.

views.name: revenue
views.statement:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('day', fct_orders.ordered_at) AS metric_time,
         SUM(CAST(fct_orders.order_amount_usd AS DECIMAL(28,6))) AS revenue
  FROM fct_orders
  WHERE (fct_orders.order_status != 'cancelled')
  GROUP BY 1
),
spine AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT date_trunc('day', CAST(date_day AS TIMESTAMP)) AS metric_time
  FROM metricflow_time_spine
)
SELECT spine.metric_time, COALESCE(base.revenue, 0) AS revenue
FROM spine LEFT JOIN base ON base.metric_time = spine.metric_time
WHERE spine.metric_time BETWEEN (SELECT MIN(metric_time) FROM base)
                            AND (SELECT MAX(metric_time) FROM base)

properties.description: Gross order revenue in USD, excluding cancelled orders and internal test accounts. Verified against the NetSuite ledger for 2026-06 (0.02% variance). NOT net of refunds — use net_revenue for that.

views.name: revenue_growth_mom
views.statement:
WITH revenue AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('month', fct_orders.ordered_at) AS metric_time,
         SUM(CAST(fct_orders.order_amount_usd AS DECIMAL(28,6))) AS revenue
  FROM fct_orders
  WHERE (fct_orders.order_status != 'cancelled')
  GROUP BY 1
),
revenue_prev_month AS (
  SELECT metric_time + INTERVAL '1 month' AS metric_time, revenue_prev_month
  FROM (
    SELECT date_trunc('month', fct_orders.ordered_at) AS metric_time,
           SUM(CAST(fct_orders.order_amount_usd AS DECIMAL(28,6))) AS revenue_prev_month
    FROM fct_orders
    WHERE (fct_orders.order_status != 'cancelled')
    GROUP BY 1
  ) t
)
SELECT revenue.metric_time,
       ((revenue - revenue_prev_month) * 100.0 / nullif(revenue_prev_month, 0)) AS revenue_growth_mom
FROM revenue
  LEFT JOIN revenue_prev_month ON revenue_prev_month.metric_time = revenue.metric_time

properties.description: Month-over-month revenue growth, percent. Null for the first month in the series.

views.name: revenue_mtd
views.statement:
WITH daily AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('day', fct_orders.ordered_at) AS metric_time,
         SUM(CAST(fct_orders.order_amount_usd AS DECIMAL(28,6))) AS v
  FROM fct_orders
  GROUP BY 1
),
spine AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT CAST(date_day AS TIMESTAMP) AS metric_time
  FROM metricflow_time_spine
)
SELECT spine.metric_time, SUM(daily.v) AS revenue_mtd
FROM spine LEFT JOIN daily
  ON daily.metric_time >= date_trunc('month', spine.metric_time)
  AND daily.metric_time <= spine.metric_time
WHERE spine.metric_time BETWEEN (SELECT MIN(metric_time) FROM daily)
                            AND (SELECT MAX(metric_time) FROM daily)
GROUP BY 1

properties.description: Revenue accumulated from the start of the calendar month.

views.name: revenue_trailing_28d
views.statement:
WITH daily AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('day', fct_orders.ordered_at) AS metric_time,
         SUM(CAST(fct_orders.order_amount_usd AS DECIMAL(28,6))) AS v
  FROM fct_orders
  GROUP BY 1
),
spine AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT CAST(date_day AS TIMESTAMP) AS metric_time
  FROM metricflow_time_spine
)
SELECT spine.metric_time, SUM(daily.v) AS revenue_trailing_28d
FROM spine LEFT JOIN daily
  ON daily.metric_time > spine.metric_time - INTERVAL '28 day'
  AND daily.metric_time <= spine.metric_time
WHERE spine.metric_time BETWEEN (SELECT MIN(metric_time) FROM daily)
                            AND (SELECT MAX(metric_time) FROM daily)
GROUP BY 1

properties.description: Rolling 28-day revenue. Requires the metricflow_time_spine model.

views.name: weekly_revenue_by_region
views.statement:
WITH revenue AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('week', fct_orders.ordered_at) AS metric_time,
         dim_customers.region AS region,
         SUM(CAST(fct_orders.order_amount_usd AS DECIMAL(28,6))) AS revenue
  FROM fct_orders
    LEFT JOIN dim_customers ON fct_orders.customer_id = dim_customers.customer_id
  WHERE (fct_orders.order_status != 'cancelled')
    AND (dim_customers.region is not null)
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
order_count AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('week', fct_orders.ordered_at) AS metric_time,
         dim_customers.region AS region,
         COUNT(fct_orders.order_id) AS order_count
  FROM fct_orders
    LEFT JOIN dim_customers ON fct_orders.customer_id = dim_customers.customer_id
  WHERE (fct_orders.order_status != 'cancelled')
    AND (dim_customers.region is not null)
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
average_order_value AS (
  WITH num AS (
    SELECT date_trunc('week', fct_orders.ordered_at) AS metric_time,
           dim_customers.region AS region,
           SUM(CAST(fct_orders.order_amount_usd AS DECIMAL(28,6))) AS num
    FROM fct_orders
      LEFT JOIN dim_customers ON fct_orders.customer_id = dim_customers.customer_id
    WHERE (fct_orders.order_status != 'cancelled')
      AND (dim_customers.region is not null)
    GROUP BY 1, 2
  ),
  den AS (
    SELECT date_trunc('week', fct_orders.ordered_at) AS metric_time,
           dim_customers.region AS region,
           COUNT(fct_orders.order_id) AS den
    FROM fct_orders
      LEFT JOIN dim_customers ON fct_orders.customer_id = dim_customers.customer_id
    WHERE (fct_orders.order_status != 'cancelled')
      AND (dim_customers.region is not null)
    GROUP BY 1, 2
  )
  SELECT den.metric_time AS metric_time,
         den.region AS region,
         CAST(COALESCE(num.num, 0) AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(CAST(den.den AS DOUBLE), 0) AS average_order_value
  FROM den LEFT JOIN num ON num.metric_time IS NOT DISTINCT FROM den.metric_time AND num.region IS NOT DISTINCT FROM den.region
)
SELECT revenue.metric_time AS metric_time,
       revenue.region AS region,
       revenue.revenue AS revenue,
       order_count.order_count AS order_count,
       average_order_value.average_order_value AS average_order_value
FROM revenue
  LEFT JOIN order_count ON order_count.metric_time IS NOT DISTINCT FROM revenue.metric_time AND order_count.region IS NOT DISTINCT FROM revenue.region
  LEFT JOIN average_order_value ON average_order_value.metric_time IS NOT DISTINCT FROM revenue.metric_time AND average_order_value.region IS NOT DISTINCT FROM revenue.region
